objective: Deliver a verified, manufacturable, inspectable and releasable K01 product definition while simultaneously building a reusable Marvilon engineering digital-thread system.
current_phase: P007 Product Definition V11 chain freeze + K01-D-006 visual QA/release-blocker closure
architecture: requirement/interface -> explicit allocation -> engineering decision/technical filter -> derived inputs + manufacturing/supplier strategy -> Product Characteristics with datum/measurement/inspection/configuration context -> deterministic CAD/PMI binding + binding-invariance verification -> split physics and variation/capability evidence -> compiled Product Definition domain slices -> drawing projection/QA -> inspection realization -> configuration/effectivity release; downstream failures return by EFR/change control
system_goal: Every expensive lesson becomes a reusable contract/tool/checkpoint so later K01 nodes and future Marvilon projects require less manual rediscovery.
non_negotiables: no new source of truth when an authority already exists
candidate verification and canonical authority change are separate
drawings derive from controlled product definition; DimXpert/PMI is preferred machine-readable tolerance/GD&T carrier
EBOM is computed from CAD occurrence tree + product registry; MBOM adds manufacturing/process structure
screening PASS never silently becomes release PASS
staleness is derived from dependencies/hashes, not manually assigned
Git and AI handoff preserve history/context but do not replace engineering authority
CURRENT is a pointer/projection convention; version numbers do not select authority
AI handoff completeness is transport assurance, not an engineering authority; active step gates check required source availability directly
no file or folder relocation is implicit; any relocation requires an explicit user-invoked action and explicit destination where applicable
Product Definition guard is a hard predecessor of drawing authoring; OPEN never becomes numeric by default
drawing_exemplar: K01-P-007 / K01-D-006 remains the first exemplar. Design-review drawing authoring may proceed only when DRAWING_CANDIDATE_READY=PASS and must consume the compiled Product Definition fingerprint. Release waits for DRAWING_RELEASE_READY.
release_target: R01 only after P6 zero-blocker condition

rules: critical control authority is exact-path declared
existing version-family debt may only shrink
new hard-coded version selectors in source are blocked
requirements evidence link does not equal qualification
CAD semantic/BOM source follows explicit engineering baseline authority
run.cmd is the single user CLI entry

drawing_and_bom_design_rule: Every change evaluates Product Characteristic/compiled Product Definition/DimXpert/drawing/inspection and EBOM/MBOM impact before mutation; downstream artifacts never become independent authority.
repository_identity_policy: Keep BreshevEngineering/marvilon-k01 as the single project repository through current engineering-baseline cleanup. Use checkpoints/branches/worktrees for clean migration; create a new repository only under an explicit migration decision with identity/evidence/history transfer manifest.

filesystem_mutation_policy.rule: No existing file or folder is moved outside its current location by generic cleanup/apply commands without an explicit per-action user command. No default destination on C: is permitted.
filesystem_mutation_policy.engineering_exception: Promotion may create new backup/staging directories and copy/replace explicitly listed canonical CAD files on D: only after the APPLY step gate passes; this is declared in the promotion manifest before execution.

current_plan: control/project/K01_NEXT_ACTIONS_CURRENT.json + control/project/K01_ACTIVE_STEP_GATE.json + control/project/K01_P0_P6_GATE_MATRIX_CURRENT.json; rendered for the user in reports/control/K01_ENGINEERING_CONTROL_PANEL_CURRENT.html
dependency_strategy: Hash-DAG + domain slices: every consumer binds to the narrowest sufficient semantic slice; shared-interface changes trigger counterpart review; stale propagation is automatic, engineering counterpart mutation is never automatic.
change_strategy: Pre-change impact analysis precedes Class A/B writes. Runtime stale state comes from MEDTAS state hashes/build records; legacy manual dependency lists are compatibility only.
drawing_pipeline_rule: Release-native drawings follow controlled D1-D9; design-review V10 is separate and non-release. Automate only deterministic/proven transport; human owns PMI authoring and visual layout at declared steps.
